correctness.rationale: The cap-at-two quotient is exact for the neighbour predicate; a tagged site follows an exact deterministic 177147-state lift. The bundled executable checks T^23=T^11 at every state, excludes periods 2 and 6 via all capped profiles, and checks equality of the complete 42-profile primitive-twelve set. A separate vertex-level implementation corroborates all period counts and multinomial formulas on nine nontrivial graph triples. The K_(5,2,3) direct witness proves the 11-step bound sharp. No finite sample is used as a substitute for the all-size quotient proof.

value.rationale: A small third part permits a nontrivial 3-by-4 twelve-step resonance on a connected graph, and a fourth vertex in that part destroys it exactly. The infinite-family labelled-state formula and sharp size-independent 11-step bound solve natural recurrence and settling-time questions, rather than a cap-table recomputation. These facts are not implied by a bipartite recurrence table or the general threshold-one theory.
